events.text:
There's no dedicated payment/credit-card class in this app — payment handling is embedded in the checkout→order pipeline. Semantic search surfaced it, then I confirmed in source:

- **Entry point**: `CartEndpoint.checkout` — `GET /cart/checkout/{cartId}` at `src/main/java/com/redhat/coolstore/rest/CartEndpoint.java:41-44`
- **Checkout logic**: `ShoppingCartService.checkOutShoppingCart` at `ShoppingCartService.java:43-52`; pricing/shipping/totals in `priceShoppingCart` at `ShoppingCartService.java:54-87` (calls remote `ShippingServiceRemote` via JNDI at `:114-125`)
- **Order dispatch**: `ShoppingCartOrderProcessor.process` sends the cart as JSON to the `java:/topic/orders` JMS topic — `ShoppingCartOrderProcessor.java:28-31`
- **Async order consumer**: `OrderServiceMDB.onMessage` receives the order, persists it via `orderService.save`, and updates inventory — `OrderServiceMDB.java:27-45`
- **Order read API**: `OrderEndpoint` `/orders` — `OrderEndpoint.java:30-40`
- **Frontend trigger**: `controllers.js:94` → `cart.js:18-22`

So "payment" here is really order placement and pricing; actual card charging (if any) would live outside this Weblogic module.
